description: Website design, custom website and web app development, a fixed-price technical audit and monthly maintenance. Each one is scoped and priced in writing before work starts.

audit.outcome: A fixed-price technical audit of an existing website or system: architecture, performance, security and SEO, returned as ranked findings and a roadmap.
audit.problem: Facing a rebuild, a slow site or an unclear technical choice?
deliverables: Risk-ranked findings across architecture, performance and SEO
A recommended rebuild-or-repair path, with its trade-offs
A roadmap any team can execute — ours or yours
audit.engagement: {auditPrice} fixed, five business days, credited against the build
audit.leaves: A written answer on rebuild or repair, in five business days.

maintenance.outcome: Website maintenance and support: monitoring, backups, security updates and a monthly allowance of edit requests, on a plan you choose.
maintenance.problem: Already live, and need it kept secure and current?
deliverables: Monitoring, patching and backups on a defined cycle
Content and small feature updates without a new project
Sites we did not build too, after a check of their current state
maintenance.leaves: Your live site kept secure, backed up and up to date.
maintenance.engagementQuoted: Billed monthly or annually, three plans

portal.outcome: Custom web application development: dashboards, client portals and internal workflows on Next.js, in a documented codebase you own.
portal.problem: Need a dashboard, portal or workflow built for your operation?
deliverables: Dashboards and workflows modelled on how your team actually operates
A typed, documented codebase on a stack you own
An automated build-and-deploy pipeline from the first release
portal.engagement: Priced from the published range by complexity, fixed in the proposal · {deliveryWeeksMin}–{deliveryWeeksMax} weeks
portal.leaves: A dashboard, client portal or internal tool built around how your team works.

website.outcome: Custom website design and build: structure, messaging and interface aimed at one action, built to published speed targets.
website.problem: Need a site that explains what you sell?
deliverables: A custom site with every language and right-to-left engineered as equals
Page structures designed around one conversion path
Built to Core Web Vitals targets
website.engagement: From {minimumEngagement}, fixed in the proposal · {deliveryWeeksMin}–{deliveryWeeksMax} weeks
website.leaves: A custom website built around one main action.

close.title: Tell us what you are building,
close.body: Describe the site, application or problem. We reply with the service that fits and the next step.

items.q: Which service should we start with?
items.a: If a site or system already exists and the problem is unclear, start with the technical audit. If you know what you need built, start with design and development. If the site is live and working, a maintenance plan keeps it that way. If you are not sure, describe the situation and we reply with the service that fits.

items.q: Can we hire you for one service only?
items.a: Yes. Each service stands on its own. You can take the audit and build elsewhere, or bring a site someone else built to a maintenance plan.

items.q: Do you work on websites you did not build?
items.a: Yes. The technical audit examines existing systems, and maintenance plans cover sites we did not build after we check their stack and current state.

Builds are priced from a published range by project type and complexity, and fixed in the proposal. The technical audit is a fixed {auditPrice}, credited against the build if you go ahead. Maintenance plans start at {maintenanceEssential} a month. Website design is part of every build; design on its own is scoped per project.
You do. Code, designs and accounts pass to you at the final payment, and audit findings are yours whether or not you build with us.
A {warrantyDays}-day warranty covers critical fixes. After that you can move to a maintenance plan, pay for changes as needed, or hand the system to your own team.
